description: Use this when the user wants their resume as a PDF file from facts they provide (name, contact line, summary, jobs with dates and bullets, education, skills, projects, certifications). Returns a one-column PDF with selectable text in reading order, a plain-text copy, a JSON copy of the data, the page count, and whether fit_to_one_page succeeded. Templates: classic, modern, compact; Letter or A4. Lays out only the text given: it does not write, embellish or verify resume content. Does not make cover letters, Word files, two-column designs or photos. Download links expire in about 1 hour.

date.description: Optional date as YYYY-MM or a year, e.g. "2023-06".

contact.description: Up to 6 contact items shown on one line, e.g. ["maria@example.com", "+1 555 0100", "Austin, TX", "linkedin.com/in/maria"].

items.description: One contact item as plain text, e.g. "maria@example.com".

education.description: Up to 8 education entries, e.g. [{"degree":"BSc Economics","school":"UT Austin","end":"2018"}].

details.description: Optional one line such as honors or coursework, e.g. "Magna cum laude".

end.description: Optional end as YYYY-MM, a year, or "present", e.g. "2018-05".

start.description: Optional start as YYYY-MM or a year, e.g. "2014".

experience.description: Up to 15 jobs in the order to print (usually newest first), e.g. [{"title":"Analyst","org":"Acme","start":"2021-03","end":"present","bullets":["Built dashboards"]}].

bullets.description: Up to 10 bullet points, e.g. ["Built the weekly pricing dashboard"].

items.description: One achievement or duty as written by the user, e.g. "Cut report time by 40%".

end.description: End month as YYYY-MM, a year, or "present", e.g. "present".

start.description: Start month as YYYY-MM (or a year), e.g. "2021-03".

fit_to_one_page.description: true to tighten spacing, margins (down to 0.5 in) and type size (down to 9 pt) so the resume fits one page. The result says if it still does not fit.

headline.description: Optional one-line professional title, e.g. "Senior Data Analyst".

name.description: Full name as it should appear, e.g. "Maria Santos".

page_size.description: Paper size: letter (US, default) or a4.

projects.description: Up to 8 projects, e.g. [{"name":"Price tracker","bullets":["Scrapes 3 stores daily"]}].

items.description: One line about the project, e.g. "Scrapes 3 stores daily".

date.description: Optional date as YYYY-MM, a year, or "present", e.g. "2024".

link.description: Optional link as plain text, e.g. "github.com/maria/price-tracker".

skills.description: Up to 60 skills, e.g. ["SQL", "Python", "Tableau"]. Items with a label and a colon print one per line.

items.description: One skill or a labeled group, e.g. "SQL" or "Languages: English, Spanish".

summary.description: Optional short profile paragraph in the user's own words, e.g. "Analyst with 6 years in retail pricing."

template.description: Layout: classic (centered header, one column), modern (left header with a blue accent rule) or compact (smaller type). Default classic.

name: generate_resume_pdf
title: Generate resume PDF
